concepts.meaning: One field owned by one Interface member and one request/result side; its identity is not its unqualified field name.
A legacy unqualified field name denotes multiple public endpoints, regardless of whether their types agree.
An authored Mapping source or target field points into an Interface and requires an unambiguous endpoint before successor migration.
A read-only source-bound report identifies candidates and ambiguity without choosing a migration or changing execution.

distinctions: same spelling is not same endpoint
same type is not same endpoint
scope resolution is not type compatibility
an Interface signature is not an Entity
